script_text: PISCES — Neptune, your ruling Water planet, is sending a bold signal this week that will shake your foundation. Early week, Mercury in Leo squares Saturn in Taurus, creating friction around contracts and conversations on Monday and Tuesday. Wednesday is clouded by a Mars square Neptune, so avoid signing documents or romantic promises before noon. Mid-week, Venus enters your 5th House on Thursday, shifting energy toward love and creative self-expression after a tense stretch. Late week, the Sun trine Jupiter in Cancer lights up your 11th House, bringing career opportunities through friendships. The weekend favors rest under a Moon in Scorpio. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House, igniting romance and creative confidence. Sunday is your worst day because Mercury stations retrograde, amplifying miscommunication and confusion. Hold off on major financial decisions until Thursday when clarity finally returns. Follow for daily updates.
